Rolling Loud India

The festival beyond the stage.

Made withRolling Loud India
Our partContent strategy · On-ground production · Live edits

Here’s the idea.

Artist encounters, audience energy, and festival stories built for the moment and the days after.

We handled end-to-end on-ground production: vox pops, artist interactions, and event coverage. Selected assets were delivered live, bringing moments from the festival into the feed while they were happening.

The rest of the work followed a structured content calendar. Explainers and atmosphere-led edits extended the story after the event, giving the coverage a life beyond a single weekend.

Live coverage has two rhythms: the moment itself, and the memory that follows.
